name: Sheraton 25O, 1BDR
headline: The 1 BDR Ruby Flatette-SO | 5 min to CAI Airport
summary: This deep red studio is perfect for small families and business travelers. The studio features a queen size comfortable bed with a working desk.

description.Space: This deep red studio is perfect for small families and business travelers.  The studio features a queen size comfortable bed with a working desk. It also features a fully loaded kitchenette, microwave, a stove top with cooking utensils, a kettle and a Nespresso coffee machine. Additionally, guests can enjoy a 55 inch smart TV for further personal entertainment.
description.Access: Guests have access to the entire apartment.
description.Interaction: Guests can text and call us anytime they need assistance. We'll be happy to address any issues right away.
description.Neighborhood:
The neighborhood is full of life with plenty of street food options (the apartment is quite and peaceful though) 

- Banks and other services are also within walking distance. 

- Cairo Complex is within 15 min walking distance and is packed with hangouts. 
- Giza Pyramids is a 50 min drive
- Downtown Cairo is a 30 min drive 
- New Cairo is a 15 min drive
- Cairo International Airport is a 5 min drive.
description.Transit:
We provide concierge services that include airport transfers and private day tours. 

All places are reachable by car, Uber app and Careem app but if you wish to take a walk it's takes no more than 5 minutes to reach any of the services around.

agreement:
Kindly note that a damage deposit of USD 100 (or the equivalent in EGP) is required. The payment is collected online as part of the reservation payment and will be reimbursed on the checkout day, provided no damages are incurred.
  • Smoking (including shisha) inside the unit is strictly not allowed. However it is allowed in the unit’s balcony (if applicable). A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.

 • Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests stated in the reservation will be granted entry. 
• Egyptian & Arab couples ONLY are required to provide proof of marriage according to Egyptian law. Guests are required to send their IDs or passports to the email (id@xurustays.com) or (id.elgouna@xurustays.com) as per the local regulations.
• El Gouna entry permits require 48 hours to be issued, in case guest IDs and passports are sent less than 48 hours before check in date, entry permits are subject to delay or may not be granted. (In case of disapproval from community security office, guests will be fully refunded).
 • Cancellation more than 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 10% of the total price of the stay.
 • Cancellation between 15 days and 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 50% of the total price of the stay. 
• Cancellation between 7 days and 15 days before the arrival date, we keep 75% of the total price of the stay.
• Less than 7 days, we keep 100% of the price of the stay
• Pets are not allowed, in case of violation, Xuru Stays has the right to cancel the reservation with no refund. 

Thank you for choosing our home for your Holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

Xuru Stays

The building is old but the apartment itself is nice, cozy, comfortable, and looks just as pictured. The space was clean, everything I needed was available, and the appliances were modern and useful.

There was a slight smell when I first arrived, but it wasn’t a major issue. The location is excellent for the airport, but the building sits directly on a very busy main road. Unfortunately, the windows provide almost no sound insulation, so traffic noise continues well into the night. It was so loud that I couldn’t sleep in the bedroom and ended up making a bed on the living room floor with both ACs, the bathroom fan, white noise, and earplugs just to get a few hours of sleep.

The bathroom toilet overflows when flushed, and the Wi-Fi details provided were incorrect, so I couldn’t connect until I found the correct QR code inside the apartment. The host was responsive, and fixing these issues would make this an excellent place to stay. Otherwise, I would recommend the apartment.
